english.title: Sing / dance / shout / play music / operate music / behave so to cause annoyance at Southampton Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[sang]_
(B)_[danced]_
(C)_[shouted]_
(D)_[played a musical instrument, namely **(..SPECIFY THE INSTRUMENT..),]_
(E)_[operated a portable music machine, namely **(..SPECIFY THE APPARATUS..),]_
(G)_[behaved]_

in such a way as to give reasonable cause for annoyance to another person at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) at Southampton Airport
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 4(7) and 2(3) of the Southampton International Airport Byelaws, 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
sang / danced / shouted / play a musical instrument or
operated portable music machine / behaved in a way
as to give reasonable cause for annoyance to another
at Southampton Airport

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

english.notes: The act in this Byelaw is prohibited unless the permission of the Airport Company has first been obtained or unless the act is performed by a person acting with lawful authority or excuse.
